last.verdict: Cloudflare's growth sped up to 39% and it lifted its full-year forecast by about $95 million, but gross margin shrank.

takeaways.label: Growth accelerating
takeaways.text: Revenue was $782.5M, up 39%, its fastest in nearly four years. That beat the company's own $736-737M forecast by roughly $46M. Future contracted revenue grew 37%.

takeaways.label: Big guidance raise
takeaways.text: Full-year 2026 revenue is now forecast at $2.963-2.964B, up from $2.864-2.870B. Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to $845-846M.

takeaways.label: Gross margin squeeze
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin fell to 72.4% from 75.3% a year ago, and to 73.1% last quarter. Costs of serving customers are growing faster than revenue.

takeaways.label: Profit up, cash flat
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating margin rose to 17.5% from 15.3%. Free cash flow was $82.1M, only 10% of revenue versus 13% a year ago, as spending on equipment rose.

history.verdict: Accelerating growth and a raised full-year outlook won buyers, though much of the after-hours pop faded.

reasons.label: Growth sped up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 36% from a year earlier, up from 34% last quarter, beating expectations.

reasons.label: Margins and one-time costs
reasons.text: Gross margin fell to 73.1% from 76.3%; a $150.7M restructuring charge weighed on results.
